components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The electric-violet action used for the clearest next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); border-radius:2px; background:var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); color:#FFFFFF; padding:12px 20px; font:500 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--devin-primary-hover, #1B00CC); border-color:var(--devin-primary-hover, #1B00CC); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Dark Header Action
components.description: The persistent high-contrast entry action in compact marketing chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:2px; background:var(--devin-ink, #191919); color:var(--devin-surface, #FCFCFC); padding:12px 16px; font:500 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background:#000000; } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-dark:active { background:#121111; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered alternative for exploration, cancellation, and non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--devin-line, rgba(0,0,0,0.12)); border-radius:2px; background:var(--devin-bg, #FFFFFF); color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); padding:12px 20px; font:500 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--devin-surface-2, #EFEFEF); border-color:rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#E5E5E5; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled white field with a hairline boundary and violet focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); font:500 13px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:44px; border:1px solid var(--devin-line, rgba(0,0,0,0.12)); border-radius:6px; background:var(--devin-bg, #FFFFFF); color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); padding:12px 14px; font:400 15px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:none; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:rgba(0,0,0,0.24); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--devin-primary, #2200FF) 16%, transparent); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A flat paper module that keeps truthful state and the next action together.
components.html:
Current site

Published

Demo Community is live and ready to share.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width:420px; border:1px solid var(--devin-line-soft, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); border-radius:16px; background:var(--devin-surface, #FCFCFC); color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); padding:24px; box-shadow:none; font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0; font-size:20px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-card-head span { border-radius:200px; background:var(--devin-surface-2, #EFEFEF); padding:4px 8px; color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); font:600 11px/1.2 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--devin-muted, #5C5C5C); font-size:15px; line-height:1.5; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact text-plus-dot state indicator; color supplements the label.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:32px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #1F8A68 28%, white); border-radius:200px; background:color-mix(in srgb, #1F8A68 9%, white); color:#176B52; padding:4px 10px; font:600 11px/1.2 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; } .ds-status::before { content:""; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#1F8A68; } .ds-status:hover { border-color:#1F8A68; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Marketing Navigation
components.description: Compact suite navigation with quiet links and a persistent dark entry action.
components.html:
YourRank
ProductsPricingStart free
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; min-height:72px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--devin-line-soft, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); background:rgba(252,252,252,0.95); padding:12px 24px; font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--devin-muted, #5C5C5C); font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav > div { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-brand { color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); font-size:15px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; border-radius:2px; background:var(--devin-ink, #191919); color:var(--devin-surface, #FCFCFC); padding:8px 14px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Divided Data Surface
components.description: The recurring row pattern for standings, rewards, workflow steps, and operational data.
components.css: .ds-data { max-width:520px; border-top:1px solid var(--devin-line, rgba(0,0,0,0.12)); border-bottom:1px solid var(--devin-line, rgba(0,0,0,0.12)); background:var(--devin-bg, #FFFFFF); color:var(--devin-ink, #191919); font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-data > div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:52px; border-top:1px solid var(--devin-line-soft, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); padding:12px 0; } .ds-data > div:first-child { border-top:0; } .ds-data span, .ds-data code { color:var(--devin-muted, #5C5C5C); font:500 12px/1.2 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-data strong { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } .ds-data > div:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--devin-surface-2, #EFEFEF) 45%, transparent); } .ds-data > div:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--devin-primary, #2200FF); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
YourRank uses one calm, high-contrast language to make a connected three-product suite immediately legible. The devin.ai reference supplies material discipline and hierarchy—near-white fields, black type, electric-violet actions, precise dividers, compact controls—while YourRank keeps its own identity, direct language, and product truth.

The system spans three distinct contexts without becoming three visual brands. Marketing explains and demonstrates Sites, Telegram, and Credits & Shop; the operator workspace places a black production rail around a light working field; public streamer sites keep a streamer-selected accent inside the same light material system. Transparent OBS overlays and isolated games remain intentional context-specific exceptions.

The product demonstration and the user's state carry each screen. Decoration stays quiet so the current state, the next action, and the relationship among the three peer products remain obvious.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white reading fields, ink-black type, and electric-violet action cues.
A black production rail around light operator workspaces.
Hairline dividers and shared outer boundaries instead of nested card stacks.
Compact identity, clear purpose, visible action, and readable state in the first viewport.
Sites, Telegram, and Credits & Shop presented as peer products under one account.

rules.name: The Two Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Violet belongs to YourRank actions and focus; the public `--yr-accent` belongs to the streamer's local identity. Do not replace one with the other.

rules.name: The State, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and danger appear in status text, dots, narrow cue bands, and alerts—not as ornamental card themes.

rules.name: The Plain Speech Rule
rules.body: Interface copy names the visible outcome—Players, Commands, Broadcasts, Rewards, Fulfilment—not the underlying infrastructure.

rules.name: The Mono Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for data, state, paths, timestamps, compact labels, and technical metadata; it is not decorative display type.

rules.name: The First Viewport Rule
rules.body: Every primary route starts with compact identity, one decisive purpose, a visible next action, and enough real or explicitly illustrative product state to understand the surface.

rules.name: The One Suite Rule
rules.body: Global product switching, account, and help remain consistent; local site and bot context never disappears in the name of simplification.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use boundaries and tonal layering for structure; add shadow only when a surface temporarily sits above the page or an action is responding to interaction.

rules.name: The Restrained Geometry Rule
rules.body: Corners communicate scale and role: near-square actions, small-radius fields, large-radius modules, and pills only for genuinely compact status or navigation objects.

rules.name: The State Before Action Rule
rules.body: When state affects a decision, show the truthful state immediately beside or before the action—published before Publish site, draft before Send, queued before Complete.

dos: **Do** keep Sites, Telegram, and Credits & Shop visible as peer products under one account.
**Do** let real user data or clearly labeled synthetic product demonstrations carry the visual hierarchy.
**Do** use shared outer boundaries, internal dividers, and readable state before introducing another container.
**Do** preserve visible focus, semantic status announcements, reduced-motion behavior, and 44px touch targets where practical.
**Do** keep public streamer accent separate from YourRank's product-action violet.
donts: **Don't** introduce decorative gradients, glass effects, glow fields, or floating metric-card walls into normal product surfaces.
**Don't** use semantic colors as decoration or communicate state by color alone.
**Don't** hide the primary action or product switcher when the layout collapses.
**Don't** turn mono labels, uppercase captions, or numbered markers into decoration; each must encode actual state, scope, sequence, or data.
**Don't** invent testimonials, customer logos, metrics, billing promises, or performance claims that the product evidence does not support.
